title: Cornerstones
author: Sotehr
rules:
RULES

Isofill

• Divide the grid into nine regions of nine orthogonally connected cells each. Fill every cell with a digit from 0 to 8 so that all cells in a region have the same digit and each digit belongs to exactly one region.

Loop

• Construct a closed loop that moves orthogonally through the centers of some cells. The loop doesn't branch or intersect and enters each region at most once. A region containing the digit N must have exactly N cells on the loop.

Arrows

• A cell with arrows contains the total number of loop cells seen in all of its arrow directions, not including itself.

Expected Difficulty: 4

Play [Cornerstones]

NOTES

Inspired by the very excellent Isofill Regional Path by Christounet, I used the same rules but made it a loop. If you haven't tried that one, or any of the other from the Isofill series started by Marty, please do!
